defs.def: to raise sb/sth or be raised to a higher position or level （被）提起，举起，抬高，吊起

ex.s: My parents used to live here and my father’s watch was here,” he explained, trying to lift a floorboard.
ex.t: 我父母以前住在这里，我父亲的手表也在这里，”他一边解释，一边试着撬起一块地板。

ex.s: To lift her spirits again.
ex.t: 重新振作精神。

ex.s: To lift the spirits of his patients and their parents.
ex.t: 振奋他的病人和他们的父母的精神。

ex.s: Finally, some girls had to lift their partners.
ex.t: 最后，一些女孩不得不举起她们的舞伴。

ex.s: Referred to as matrix planting, this approach aims for nature to do a lot more of the heavy lifting in the garden, and even some of the designing.
ex.t: 这种方法被称为“矩阵种植”，旨在让自然在花园中承担更多繁重工作，甚至部分设计。

ex.s: Our waiter advised us to lift the plates and bowls close to our faces.
ex.t: 我们的服务员建议我们把盘子和碗举到靠近脸的地方。

defs.def: to take hold of sb/sth and move them/it to a different position 移开；移动
to transport people or things by air 空运
to remove or end restrictions 解除，撤销，停止（限制）
to become or make sb more cheerful 高兴起来；使更愉快

ex.s: This stranger became my cheerleader, as if it was his mission to lift me up from my  28 .
ex.t: 这位陌生人成了我的啦啦队长，仿佛他的使命就是把我从28 中拉起来。

ex.s: After twenty minutes, Peter felt happy when he saw the medics lifting the boy, now is talking, into the ambulance.
ex.t: 二十分钟后，当彼得看到医护人员把那个男孩（现在在说话了）抬上救护车时，他感到很高兴。

defs.def: to rise and disappear 消散；消失
to steal sth 偷盗；盗窃
to use sb's ideas or words without asking permission or without saying where they come from 剽窃；盗用；抄袭
to dig up vegetables or plants from the ground 挖出，刨出，拔起（蔬菜或植物）
to make the amount or level of sth greater; to become greater in amount or level 提高；增加；（使）增长

ex.s: In truth, even if they had decided to put it on top of the cathedral, given its weight, they had no way to lift it that high.
ex.t: 事实上，即使他们决定把它放在大教堂顶部，考虑到它的重量，他们也根本无法把它举那么高。

ex.s: I find during the winter months, plants around the house can really lift your mood.” Several studies have backed this up and found that indoor plants can improve creativity, focus and memory.
ex.t: 我发现在冬季的几个月里，房子周围的植物真的能提振你的情绪。”多项研究证实了这一点，发现室内植物可以提高创造力、专注力和记忆力。

defs.def: a machine that carries people or goods up and down to different levels in a building or a mine 电梯；升降机

ex.s: rush quickly to a lift
ex.t: A．快速冲向电梯

ex.s: We’ve all been there: in a lift, in line at the bank or on an airplane, surrounded by people who are, like us, deeply focused on their smartphones or, worse, struggling with the uncomfortable silence.
ex.t: 我们都经历过这样的情况：在电梯里、在银行排队或在飞机上，周围的人像我们一样全神贯注地看着智能手机，或者更糟的是，在不舒服的沉默中挣扎。

ex.s: •Exit immediately from the nearest emergency exit；do not use a lift．
ex.t: •立即从最近的紧急出口撤离；不要使用电梯。

ex.s: 37     Our building even had a tiny lift with a female voice that said, “Ouverture des portes,” in perfect French.
ex.t: 37 我们的大楼甚至有一部小小的电梯，里面有个女声用完美的法语说“开门”。

defs.def: a free ride in a car, etc. to a place you want to get to 免费搭车；搭便车
a feeling of being happier or more confident than before 较好的心情；更大的信心
a movement in which sth rises or is lifted up 提；抬；举；上升；吊

ex.s: The Texas-based company has developed and patented scooping and lifting technology to move massive trees.
ex.t: "我[已经]为此失去了足够的睡眠，"该公司西部副总裁大卫·考克斯说——那还是在医院提到这棵树的显赫出身之前。

ex.s: Before the heavy lifting began, the team assessed the root system and dug a five-foot-deep cylinder , measuring 40 feet in diameter, around the trunk to protect all essential roots.
ex.t: 在重型吊装开始前，团队先评估了根系，并在树干周围挖了一个深五英尺、直径40英尺的圆柱形坑，以保护所有重要的根部。

ex.s: Mom lifted me out of the car and  38  to speak to the driver.
ex.t: 妈妈把我从车里抱出来，____38____去和司机说话。

ex.s: The boy lifted the last bag onto his shoulder, and flashed a bright smile.
ex.t: 男孩把最后一个袋子扛到肩上，露出了灿烂的笑容。

ex.s: Famous speeches during wartime have lifted hearts in dark times, given hope to despair, honoured the dead and even changed the course of history.
ex.t: 战时著名的演讲在黑暗时期鼓舞了人心，给绝望带来了希望，缅怀了逝者，甚至改变了历史的进程。
